description: Defines the Metadata class which manages key-value metadata associated with build targets, including functions for rebasing values and collecting walk targets. It includes references to build settings, scope, and source directory classes.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Manages metadata key-value pairs for build targets, including rebasing and walk target collection.

methods.name: origin
methods.description: Returns the origin parse node of the metadata.

methods.name: set_origin
methods.description: Sets the origin parse node of the metadata.

methods.name: contents
methods.description: Returns the contents (key-value map) of the metadata.

methods.name: set_contents
methods.description: Sets the contents (key-value map) of the metadata.

methods.name: source_dir
methods.description: Returns the source directory associated with the metadata.

methods.name: set_source_dir
methods.description: Sets the source directory for the metadata.

methods.name: WalkStep
methods.description: Collects metadata for walk targets based on specified keys, rebase directory, and build settings.

methods.name: RebaseValue
methods.description: Rebases a value according to build settings and rebase directory.
